notes.title: 🔥 Surviving Gothic Hell: What’s Coming Next 🔥
notes.content:
[p]Hello Survivors![/p][p]Here’s what we’re [i]actively[/i] working on to make every descent deadlier and more rewarding:[/p][list][*][p]Loot/Inventory system -[b] loot[/b] to discover and twist into powerful builds[/p][/*][*][p]Greater [b]versatility in playstyles[/b] – go full glass cannon, lightning-fast, tanky with armor, or even summon the damned to fight for you[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]events on the map[/b] to surprise and punish between swarms[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded arsenal of [b]spells, upgrades, and relics[/b] so every run feels unique[/p][/*][*][p]Better Cards description [/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss encounters[/b] that will test how creative (or reckless) your build really is[/p][/*][*][p]More [b][i][u]content[/u][/i][/b] for [b]Next Steam Fest Demo[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Ongoing polish: darker visuals, richer atmosphere, smoother progression and more [b][u]CLEAR understanding[/u][/b] what happening on screen when the bullet hell starts.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Why wishlist now?[/b]
Each update grows the chaos: more loot, more builds, more ways to carve your path through hell. Wishlisting lets you be part of the run from the start - and ensures you won’t miss when the next wave hits.[/p][p][b]P.S.[/b] We know the current demo is bite-sized, but thanks to your feedback it’s now more stable at its core. Next step: adding content until the minimum gameplay time hits ~[b]1-2 hours[/b] per run - without repeating builds or events.[/p][p]The Gothic Hell never waits. Survivors, prepare yourselves - [b]Wishlist Now[/b].[/p]

notes.title: We've updated the Demo based on your feedback!
notes.content:
[p]Thanks to all your feedback, we’ve been hard at work improving the demo![/p][list][*][p]Fixed hundreds of crashes and performance issues[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted balancing for a smoother experience[/p][/*][*][p]Overall polish and stability improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed auto benchmark - now it doesn't setup Epic settings for everyone.[/p][/*][*][p]UI/UX cleaning[/p][/*][*][p]Working towards making it playable on [b]Steam Deck[/b] and consoles[/p][/*][/list][p]The demo is still bite-sized, but now much more stable and enjoyable.
If you like what you see, don’t forget to [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b] — it really helps us out![/p][p][b]P.S.[/b] We have MORE content in the works, but we’re preparing it for a big event like [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] to make our demo truly stand out![/p]

notes.title: Demo Available Now
notes.content: [p]We’ve just published a short demo of [i]Gothic Hell: Survivors[/i] for you to try.[/p][p]It’s an early slice — focused on core gameplay.[/p][p]Feedback is welcome![/p][p]▶️ [b]Download the demo now and let us know what you think.[/b][/p]

notes.title: We Won Best Gameplay at Game Con Canada 2025
notes.content:
[p]Last weekend at Game Con Canada 2025 (June 15), [b]Gothic Hell: Survivors[/b] took home the [b]Best Gameplay Award[/b] - and we’re still buzzing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618848/8a64b20e7728824335db26ee98aa9e619d3b4369.png"][/img][/p][p]Big thanks to everyone who dropped by our booth, played the demo, gave feedback, or just watched the chaos unfold.
Special shoutout to the 4-year-old who beat the boss faster than any adult. Absolute unit.[/p][p]The jury from [url="https://www.cgmagonline.com/articles/features/best-indie-game-con-canada/"]CGMagazine[/url] called it "refined, addictive, and overwhelmingly fun."
We call it a sign to keep pushing harder.[/p][p]Next step - getting the public demo ready. It’s coming soon.
Stay brutal. Stay curious. And yeah, wishlist if you haven’t already.[/p][p][b]– KIB Games[/b][/p]
